details.text:
Owner decisions (2026-11-09), to be logged in the audit log with date/time:
a. Add octave-band features to src/pilot.py: bands 50 Hz-12 kHz octaves plus a
   50-500 Hz band, computed from the same 24 kHz stream, stored per 5-minute
   block (relative levels, not calibrated). Fix exact band edges in code and
   in docs/eval_plan.md BEFORE any further run. This implements eval plan
   section 5; it is not an amendment. Re-run the 60 pilot days with it and
   mark the old pilot outputs superseded.
b. Trim ANY overlap at file boundaries; stitch at exact timestamps; do not
   bridge real gaps (windows only inside continuous stretches). Stamp every
   output file with pipeline_version and the git commit. Log as a pipeline
   change.
c. Commit the pilot review script and docs/pilot_review.md, labelled
   "exploratory, train/val days only, no model or threshold choices made".
   Log that labels were compared with zero-shot scores on 60 train/val days
   before the full run, and that no test-day audio or labels were touched.
d. I will save a snapshot (PDF) of the Kaggle model page into docs/evidence/.
   When it exists, record its SHA-256 and date in the audit log. Note in
   docs/model_notes.md that the downloaded model folder contains no license
   file. Not blocking.
e. Verify sanctsound_README.pdf against the bucket object
   sanctsound/README.pdf (expected 13,252 bytes, MD5 base64
   8T5qa4rN+wz0viB3elrBoA==). Do NOT commit the PDF. Record URL, size, hashes
   and retrieval date in docs/data_sources.md and the audit log.
Also add to the day table a zero_fraction field per day and flag days over 1%
zeros (sb01_02); plan a sensitivity analysis that excludes them.
RUN ORDER: process the 300 train/val days first (including the 60 pilot days),
in tmux, resumable. Do not process test days until I say so.
